verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              किमसौ पाण्डवो राजा धर्मपुत्रोऽभ्यभाषत। श्रुत्वेह बहुलाः सेनाः प्रीत्यर्थं नः समागताः॥१॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said What did the son of Dharma, the king of the Pandavas, say after hearing that several armies had collected here for our help.

verses.sanskrit: किमसौ चेष्टते सूत योत्स्यमानो युधिष्ठिरः। के वाऽस्य भ्रातृपुत्राणां पश्यन्त्याज्ञेप्सवो मुखम्॥२॥
verses.english: What preparations are Yudhishthira, who is ready for war, making? Who among his sons and brothers are looking up to his face desirous of receiving his orders?

verses.sanskrit: के स्विदेनं वारयन्ति युद्धाच्छाम्येति वा पुनः। निकृत्या कोपितं मन्दैर्धर्मज्ञं धर्मचारिणम्॥३॥
verses.english: Who among them again dissuades him from war, saying-“Be peaceful” him who knows the nature of virtue and who practices virtue and who has been moved to wrath by the wrong done by the wicked ones (my sons).

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              राज्ञोमुखमुदीक्षन्ते पाञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह। युधिष्ठिरस्य भद्रं ते स सर्वाननुशास्ति च॥४॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said All the the Panchalas, along with the Pandavas, are looking up to the face of the king Yudhishthira and he, good betide you, rules over them all.

verses.sanskrit: पृथग्भूताः पाण्डवानां पाञ्चालानां रथव्रजाः। आयान्तमभिनन्दन्ति कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्॥५॥
verses.english: Hosts of cars belonging to the Panchalas are coming separately and inspire joy into the heart of Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti.

verses.sanskrit: नभःसूर्यमिवोद्यन्तं कौन्तेयं दीप्ततेजसम्। पाञ्चालाः प्रतिनन्दन्ति तेजोराशिमिवोदितम्॥६॥
verses.english: The Panchalas like a cluster of rays gladden the heart of the son of Kunti, who is of effulgent prowess, like the sun rising making the sky look cheerful.

verses.sanskrit: आगोपालाविपालाश्च नन्दमाना युधिष्ठिरम्। पाञ्चालाः केकया मत्स्याः प्रतिनन्दन्ति पाण्डवम्॥७॥
verses.english: Down to the very herdsmen who look after cattle and sheep, the tribes of Panchalas, Kaikeya and Matsyas gladden the heart of Yudhishthira, the Pandu king.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मण्यो राजपुत्र्यश्च विशां दुहितरश्च याः। क्रीडन्त्योऽभिसमायान्ति पार्थं सन्नद्धमीक्षितुम्॥८॥
verses.english: The daughters of Brahmanas and of chieftains and of the Vaishyas, while playing, come to Partha to see him clad in a coat of mail.

verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              सञ्जयाचक्ष्व येनास्मान् पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत। धृष्टद्युम्नस्य सैन्येन सोमकानां बलेन च॥९॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said O Sanjaya, tell us about those with whose aid that Pandu king will high, viz., the army of Dhrishtadyumna and of the Somakas.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              गावल्गणिस्तु तत् पृष्टः सभायां कुरुसंसदि। निःश्वस्य सुभृशं दीर्घं मुहुः सञ्चिन्तयन्निव॥१०॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said The son of Gavalgani, being thus questioned in that council of the assembly of Kurus and having drawn long sighs, again and again became thoughtful for a moment.
verses.bhavadeepa: येन सहायेन अस्मानालक्ष्य अभ्ययुञ्जत संनद्धा अभूवन् ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: तत्रानिमित्ततो दैवात् सूतं कश्मलमाविशत्। तदाचचक्षे विदुरः सभायां राजसंसदि॥११॥
verses.english: Without any reason, as if by the hand of the gods, the Suta suddenly fell down. Then in that assembly of kings, in that council chamber, Vidura said loudly-This Sanjaya, O great king, has fallen down senseless; and he cannot utter one word bereft of his wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: सञ्जयोऽयं महाराज मूर्छितः पतितो भुवि। वाचं न सृजते काञ्चिद्धीनप्रज्ञोऽल्पचेतनः॥१२॥

धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              अपश्यत् सञ्जयो नूनं कुन्तीपुत्रान् महारथान्। तैरस्य पुरुषव्याघ्रैर्भृशमुद्द्वेजितं मनः॥१३॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said Sanjaya, seeing these mighty car-warriors, the sons of Kunti, has certainly got his mind excited owing to those tigers among men.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              सञ्जयश्चेतनां लब्ध्वा प्रत्याश्वस्येदभब्रवीत्। धृतराष्ट्र महाराज सभायां कुरुसंसदि॥१४॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Sanjaya having regained consciousness and being comforted addressed these words to the great king, Dhritarashtra, amidst that assemblage of Kurus in that hall.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              दृष्टवानस्मि राजेन्द्र कुन्तीपुत्रान् महारथान्। मत्स्यराजगृहावासनिरोधेनावकर्शितान्॥१५॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said I have seen, O chief among kings, those mighty car-warriors, the sons of Kunti, grown lean through the restraint in which they lived in the court of the Matsya king.

verses.sanskrit: श्रृणु र्यैर्हि महाराज पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत। धृष्टद्युम्नेन वीरेण युद्धे वस्तेऽभ्ययुञ्जत॥१६॥
verses.english: Hear, O great king, aided by whom the Pandavas will fight. There will he fight between yourselves and them, aided by the hero Dhrishtadyumna.

verses.sanskrit: यो नैव रोषान्न भयान्न लोभान्नार्थकारणात्। न हेतुवादाद्धर्मात्मा सत्यं जाह्यात् कदाचन॥१७॥
verses.english: That man of virtuous soul who, through wealth and fear, avarice or wealth or for the sake of argument never falls from truth.

verses.sanskrit: यः प्रमाणं महाराज धर्मे धर्मभृतां वरः। अजातशत्रुणा तेन पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥१८॥
verses.english: Who is an authority, O great king, in religious matters and who is the chief among men attached to virtue, who has created no enemies, aided by him the Pandavas will fight with you.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य बाहुबले तुल्यः पृथिव्यां नास्ति कश्चन। यो वै सर्वान् महीपालान् वशे चक्रे धनुर्धरः। यः काशीनङ्गमगधान् कलिङ्गांश्च युधाऽजयत्॥१९॥
verses.english: Whose equal in strength of arms there is none in those world; that wielder of the bow who subdued all protectors of the earth and who subjugated in battle the people of Kashi, Anga and Magadha and also the Kalingas.

verses.sanskrit: तेन वो भीमसेनेन पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत। यस्य वीर्येण सहसा चत्वारो भुवि पाण्डवाः॥२०॥
verses.english: With that Bhimasena the Pandavas will fight with you; and through whose prowess the four Pandavas came down.

verses.sanskrit: निःसृत्य जतुगेहाद्वै हिडिम्बात् पुरुषादकात्। यश्चैषामभवद्द्वीपः कुन्तीपुत्रो वृकोदरः॥२१॥
verses.english: After issuing from the house of lac, Vrikodara, the son of Kunti, who became the means of their rescue from Hidimba, the man eater.

verses.sanskrit: याज्ञसेनीमथो यत्र सिन्धुराजोऽपकृष्टवान्। तत्रैषामभवद्द्वीपः कुन्तीपुत्रो वृकोदरः॥२२॥
verses.english: That son of Kunti, Vrikodara, who became the means of rescue at the time when Sindhuraja was gratifying his lust on the daughter of Yajnasena.

verses.sanskrit: यश्च तान् सङ्गतान् सर्वान् पाण्डवान् वारणावते। दह्यतो मोचयामास तेन वस्तेऽभ्ययुञ्जत॥२३॥
verses.english: Aided by him who liberated all the assembled Pandavas when they were burning at the conflagration of Varanavata they will fight against you.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णायां चरता प्रीतिं येन क्रोधवशा हताः। प्रविश्य विषयं घोरं पर्वतं गन्धमादनम्॥२४॥
verses.english: Aided by him whom to gratify Krishna (Draupadi) killed the the Krodhavasas after penetrating into the terrific mountain Gandhamadana.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य नागायुतैर्वीर्यं भुजयोः सारमर्पितम्। तेन वो भीमसेनेन पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥२५॥
verses.english: By him whose substantial arms the strength of ten thousands has been given by the aid of such Brahmana will the Pandavas fight with you.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णद्वितीयो विक्रम्य तुष्ट्यर्थं जातवेदसः। अजयद्यः पुरा वीरो युध्यमानं पुरन्दरम्॥२६॥
verses.english: That hero who, in days of old, for the satisfaction of the god of fire, aided by Krishna, conquered Purandara (Indra) fighting.

verses.sanskrit: यः स साक्षान्महादेवं गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम्। तोषयामास युद्धेन देवदेवमुमापतिम्॥२७॥
verses.english: He who passed by his fight that god among gods, the lord of Uma-that Mahadeva himself, with the trident in his hand, that lord of the mountains.

verses.sanskrit: यश्च सर्वान् वशे चक्रे लोकपालान् धनुर्धरः। तेन वो विजयेनाजौ पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥२८॥
verses.english: That wielder of the bow, who subjugated all the rulers of the earth by the aid of that Vijaya will the Pandavas fight.

verses.sanskrit: यः प्रतीचीं दिशं चक्रे वशे म्लेच्छगणायुताम्। स तत्र नकुलो योद्धा चित्रयोधी व्यवस्थितः॥२९॥
verses.english: He, who subjugated the western country inhabited by hordes of Mlecchas, that warrior Nakula of wonderful weapons is present in their camp.

verses.sanskrit: तेन वो दर्शनीयेन वीरेणातिधनुर्भृता। माद्रीपुत्रेण कौरव्य पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥३०॥
verses.english: With that beautiful hero, that excellent wielder of your bow, the son of Madri, O Kurus, will the sons of Pandu fight. With that Sahadeva, who conquired the kings of Kashi, Anga, Magadha and Kalinga in bettle, will the sons of Pandu fight.

verses.sanskrit: यः काशीनङ्गमगधान् कलिङ्गांश्च युधाऽजयत्। तेन वः सहदेवेन पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥३१॥
यस्य वीर्येण सदृशाश्चत्वारो भुवि मानवाः। अश्वत्थामा धृष्टकेतू रुक्मी प्रद्युम्न एव च॥३२॥
verses.english: He whose might is equaled by only four men in this world, Ashvathaman, Dhrishtaketu, Rukmi and Pradyumna; with that Sahadeva, with that hero among men and with that joygiver to Madri, O king, will you have a great fight.

verses.sanskrit: तेन वः सहदेवेन युद्धं राजन् महात्ययम्। यवीयसा नृवीरेण माद्रीनन्दिकरेण च॥३३॥
तपश्चचार या घोरं काशिकन्या पुरा सती। भीष्मस्य वधमिच्छन्ती प्रेत्यापि भरतर्षभ॥३४॥
verses.english: The chaste woman, the daughter of the king of Kashi, who practiced austere asceticism, who was desirous of the destruction of Bhishma even after death (i.e. in another birth) O bull of the race of Bharata, was born as the daughter of the king of Panchala and by the hand of the gods she became a male afterwards; that one, O tiger among men, who knows the virtues and vices of female-males.

verses.sanskrit: पाञ्चालस्य सुता जज्ञे दैवाच्च स पुनः पुमान्। स्त्रीपुंसोः पुरुषव्याघ्र यः स वेद गुणागुणान्॥३५॥
यः कलिङ्गान् समापेदे पाञ्चाल्यो युद्धदुर्मदः। शिखण्डिना वः कुरवः कृतास्त्रेणाभ्ययुञ्जत॥३६॥
verses.english: Who fought with the Kalingas, that prince of Panchala; hard to vanquish in battle with that Shikhandin skillful in the use of weapons will they fight with you, the Kurus.

verses.sanskrit: यं यक्षः पुरुषं चक्रे भीष्मस्य निधनेच्छया। महेष्वासेन रौद्रेण पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥३७॥
verses.english: She who was turned into a male through a desire for the death of Bhishma, with that terrific bowman will the Pandavas fight.

verses.sanskrit: महेष्वासा राजपुत्रा भ्रातरः पञ्च केकयाः। आमुक्तकवचाः शूरास्तैश्च वस्तेऽभ्ययुञ्जत॥३८॥
verses.english: With those five Kaikeya princes, brothers to one another and mighty bowmen, with these heroes; with the coats of arms on will they fight with you.

verses.sanskrit: यो दीर्घबाहुः क्षिप्रास्त्रो धृतिमान् सत्यविक्रमः। तेन वो वृष्णिवीरेण युयुधानेन सङ्गरः॥३९॥
verses.english: With that heroe among the race of the Vrishnis, of long arms, of great activity in the use of weapons, possessed of true strength, with that Suyodhana will you have to fight.

verses.sanskrit: य आसीच्छरणं काले पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। रणे तेन विराटेन भविता वः समागमः॥४०॥
verses.english: He who has been the protector of the greatsouled Pandavas for a time, with that Virata will you meet in battle.

verses.sanskrit: यः स काशिपती राजा वाराणस्यां महारथः। स तेषामभवद्योद्धा तेन वस्तेऽभ्ययुञ्जत॥४१॥
verses.english: He who is the Lord of Kashi, the carwarrior who is the king of Varanasi, has become their warrior, with him they will fight with you.

verses.sanskrit: शिशुभिर्दुर्जयैः सङ्ख्ये द्रौपदेयैर्महात्मभिः। आशीविषसमस्पर्शैः पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥४२॥
verses.english: With the children hard to vanquish, the sons of Draupadi of noble souls, who are like snakes, will the Pandavas fight.

verses.sanskrit: यः कृष्णासदृशो वीर्ये युधिष्ठिरसमो दमे। तेनाभिमन्युना सङ्ख्ये पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥४३॥
verses.english: He who is like Krishna in strength and like Yudhishthira in self-control, with that Abhimanyu will the Pandavas fight.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चैवाप्रतिमो वीर्ये धृष्टकेतुर्महायशाः। दुःसहः समरे क्रुद्धः शैशुपालिर्महारथः॥४४॥
verses.english: Dhrishtaketu of great fame, who is of unparalleled strength, who wrathful in battle is hard to vanquish, that son of Shishupala, a great car-warrior, with him, the king of the Chedis who has come and joined the Pandavas with an Akshauhini, will the Pandavas fight.

verses.sanskrit: तेन वश्चेदिराजेन पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत। अक्षौहिण्या परिवृतः पाण्डवान्योऽभिसंश्रितः॥४५॥
यः संश्रयः पाण्डवानां देवानामिव वासवः। तेन वो वासुदेवेन पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥४६॥
verses.english: He who is the refuge of the Pandavas as Vasava is of the gods, with that Vamdeva will the Pandavas fight.

verses.sanskrit: यथा चेदिपतेर्भ्राता शरभो भरतर्षभ। करकर्षेण सहितस्ताभ्यां वस्तेऽभ्ययुञ्जत॥४७॥
verses.english: So also will the brother of the king of the Chedis, Sharabha, O bull of the race of Bharata who is accompanied by Karakarsha with these two will the Pandavas fight.

verses.sanskrit: जारासन्धिः सहदेवो जयत्सेनश्च तावुभौ। युद्धे प्रतिरथे वीरौ पाण्डवार्थे व्यवस्थितौ॥४८॥
verses.english: The son of Jarasandha, Sahadeva and Jayatsena, both of whom are unrivaled heroes in battle, are present in the cause of the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: द्रुपदश्च महातेजा बलेन महता वृतः। त्यक्तात्मा पाण्डवार्थाय योत्स्यमानो व्यवस्थितः॥४९॥
verses.english: Drupada too of great prowess and surrounded by a large force has sacrificed his interests for the Pandava's cause and desirous of fighting is present.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवः प्राच्योदीच्या महीक्षितः। शतशो यानुपाश्रिता धर्मराजो व्यवस्थितः॥५०॥
verses.english: These and many others come from the countries in the east and the north depending on hundreds of them the king Dharma is prepared for battle.
